name: Ogre
ability: On your 1st night, choose a player (not yourself): you become their alignment (you don't know which) even if drunk or poisoned.
designRole: Starts choosing a friend and joins their alignment without learning it.
explanation: Starts choosing a friend and joins their alignment without learning it.

jinxes.reason: The Demon cannot have the Ogre ability.
If the Pit-Hag turns an evil player into the Ogre, they can't turn good due to their own ability.
If the Recluse registers as evil to the Ogre, the Ogre learns that they are evil.
The Spy registers as evil to the Ogre.
